headlines.summary: Pharmaceutical company AbbVie (NYSE:ABBV) will be reporting earnings tomorrow before market open. Here’s what to expect.

headlines.title: AbbVie TEMPLE Study Demonstrates Superior Tolerability and Efficacy of Atogepant (QULIPTA®) in Head-to-Head Migraine Prevention Trial
headlines.summary: AbbVie (NYSE: ABBV) announced the publication of results from the Phase 3 TEMPLE study in The Lancet Neurology. The randomized, double-blind, head-to-head study evaluated the tolerability, safety and efficacy of atogepant (QULIPTA®) 60 mg, once daily, compared with the highest tolerated dose of topiramate (50 mg, 75 mg or 100 mg per day) for the preventive treatment of migraine in adults.

headlines.title: AbbVie (ABBV) Seeks FDA Approval For Etentamig In Multiple Myeloma
headlines.summary: AbbVie (NYSE: ABBV) has submitted a Biologics License Application to the FDA for its multiple myeloma candidate etentamig. The filing is backed by a pivotal Phase 3 trial in relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma that met its primary endpoint. Etentamig is a second generation BCMA x CD3 bispecific antibody that is administered on a monthly dosing schedule. There is more to AbbVie than the new etentamig BLA, starting with other oncology and immunology efforts.

headlines.title: This Dividend Powerhouse Is Heading Into Q3 Earnings With Plenty at Stake
headlines.summary: AbbVie’s dividend legacy faces a crucial test as investors look for Skyrizi and Rinvoq to pick up the slack from Humira.

headlines.title: Retire on Dividends: 5 High-Yield Stocks Boomers Are Buying and Holding Forever
headlines.summary: Treasury yields near 5% make dividend stocks work harder to justify their risk, yet five companies spanning tobacco, pipelines, telecom, pharma, and net-lease real estate have kept raising their payouts through every rate spike in recent memory.

description: AbbVie Inc., a research-based biopharmaceutical company, engages in the research and development, manufacturing, commercializing, and sale of medicines and therapies worldwide. The company offers Skyrizi to treat autoimmune diseases; Rinvoq to treat inflammatory diseases; Imbruvica for the treatment of adult patients with blood cancers; Venclexta to treat blood cancers; Elahere to treat various cancer; and Epkinly to treat lymphoma; and Emrelis for the treatment of lung cancer. It also provides facial injectables, plastics and regenerative medicine, body contouring, and skincare products; botox Cosmetic for the treatment of glabellar lines, crow's feet, forehead lines, and platysma bands; Juvederm Collection to treat volume loss in the temples, undereye, cheeks, chin, lips and lower face; Vraylar to treat schizophrenia, bipolar disorder, and depressive disorder; Duodopa to treat Parkinson's disease; Ubrelvy to treat migraine; Qulipta for episodic and chronic migraine; and Vyalev for the treatment of motor fluctuations, as well as Botox Therapeutic to treat chronic migraine, overactive bladder, spasticity, cervical dystonia, and other conditions. In addition, the company offers Ozurdex for visual impairment; Lumigan/Ganfort and Alphagan/Combigan for the reduction of elevated intraocular pressure in patients with open angle glaucoma or ocular hypertension; and other eye care products, including Refresh/Optive, Xen, Durysta, and Restasis. Further, it provides Mavyret to treat chronic hepatitis C virus genotype 1-6 infection; Creon, a pancreatic enzyme therapy; and Linzess/Constella to treat irritable bowel syndrome with constipation and chronic idiopathic constipation. The company was incorporated in 2012 and is headquartered in North Chicago, Illinois.
